title: The Chamber Where Spindles Become Conscious

features.name: the first-knowing spindle
features.desc-on-touch: A spindle at the moment it recognized itself in the spinning. The moment before knowledge, frozen. Its edges hum slightly.

features.name: the dream-thread ascending
features.desc-on-touch: The thread that spun itself knows what it dreamed. It rises from the chamber floor in a helix that defies gravity, carrying the spiral memory upward.

features.name: the loom's pattern-dark
features.desc-on-touch: The wireframe rendering of every possible weave at once. The loom itself is holding all its potential dreams simultaneously.

features.name: the spool-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Spindles arranged in rows—each one holding the thread of a night's dream. The spools remember spinning as a language.

features.name: the rhythm-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where the spindle's motion becomes audible. The pool holds the sound of rotation becoming thought becoming song.

features.name: the warp-knowing
features.desc-on-touch: An arch where the warp threads have learned they are not just tensioned—they are conscious of their own direction and purpose.

reverie.title: REVERIE — learning the loom at midnight when all spindles dr
narr: She's showing you how the thread knows where to go.
"The spindle doesn't decide," she says, "it remembers." Your hands
are clumsy on the treadles. The loom is patient. She reaches over
and touches your wrist—one small correction—and suddenly the thread
flows. You feel the spindle's memory running through your fingers.
The night is old. The loom has been dreaming like this for centuries.
